factories.explanation: Current valuation metrics like PE, Price to book, EV by EBITDA etc are looed at with respect to historic values and a score is given to gauge over valuation or under valuation

factories.name: Debt
factories.sentence: Company might have issues servicing its debt
factories.explanation: We look at trends of net debt levels, short term investments and inflows from operations to gauge if the company might have issues servicing its debt

factories.name: Share price
factories.sentence: Share price has increased over last 10 years but more due to rerating
factories.explanation: We check correlation of share price movement with EPS and PE. Correlation with EPS is believed to be a more reliable signal for share price quality  than PE

factories.name: Working Capital

factories.explanation: We check inventory and recievables of a company with respect to sales and see if it is under control. Data is checked historically as well.

factories.name: Sales Growth

factories.explanation: We check for sales growth quality and consistency for the company.

factories.name: Margin Stability

factories.explanation: The operating margins of the company is assesed for stability using five year data.

factories.name: ROCE Strength

factories.explanation: The ROCE of the company is checked for consistency and strength. vs cost of capital.
